items.title: Vertiv Holdings Co (VRT) Locked In Three Years Of AI Power Chip Supply
items.summary: Vertiv Holdings Co (NYSE:VRT) agreed to a three-year partnership with Infineon Technologies to secure power semiconductor supply for AI infrastructure. The Infineon arrangement covers components for Vertiv's next-generation digital infrastructure and 800 VDC power systems used in AI data centers. Vertiv also expanded work with Dassault Systèmes and NVIDIA to combine virtual twin design with pre-engineered AI factory reference architectures. These moves connect Vertiv’s Infineon supply deal...
